method: generalized least squares (GLS) framework of the Distance Network
description: Covariance-weighted combination of geometric anchors, primary distance indicators (Cepheid, TRGB), secondary (SNe Ia, SBF), and Hubble-flow measurements to fit consensus H0.
commitments: Build full covariance matrix accounting for shared anchors, hosts, method systematics, peculiar velocities, intrinsic scatters.
Fit global H0, absolute magnitudes for SNIa (M_B), SBF (M_F110W per group), inter-calibration zero-points for primary methods.
Geometric anchors as fixed or weakly constrained inputs.
Hubble flow: low-z approximation mu=5*log10(cz/H0)+25, corrected for peculiar velocity.
